definition: AUTOMATIC1111 Stable Diffusion Web UI (SD WebUI, A1111, or Automatic1111) is an open source generative artificial intelligence program that allows users to generate images from a text prompt.
details: It uses Stable Diffusion as the base model for its image capabilities together with a large set of extensions and features to customize its output.

explainer.lead: AUTOMATIC1111 is an open-source program for turning written descriptions into images with Stable Diffusion. It pairs that base model with many features and extensions, giving users ways to customize the images they generate.

tiers.eli5: Imagine a talented artist who draws whatever you describe. AUTOMATIC1111 is like the desk and toolbox around that artist: you write your idea, Stable Diffusion does the drawing, and extra tools help change the result. The final picture is created from your words rather than drawn by hand.
tiers.practitioner: Use AUTOMATIC1111 as the program around a Stable Diffusion base model: supply a text prompt, then apply its features and extensions to customize generated images. Treat those customization choices as part of the workflow because they can affect the output. When documenting a setup, distinguish the Web UI from the underlying Stable Diffusion model.
tiers.paperLevel: Functionally, AUTOMATIC1111 can be written as x = A1111(t; C), where t is a text prompt, C denotes its customization features and extensions, and x is the generated image. Stable Diffusion supplies the base image-generation model.

explainer.example: A user enters the prompt "a red bicycle beside a lake at sunrise." AUTOMATIC1111 uses Stable Diffusion to generate the scene, while its available features and extensions can be used to customize the resulting image.

usedIn.name: Text-to-image generation
usedIn.detail: Turning a written prompt into an image with Stable Diffusion.

usedIn.name: Customized image-generation workflows
usedIn.detail: Using its extensions and features to tailor generated output.

explainer.intuition: Think of Stable Diffusion as the image-making engine and AUTOMATIC1111 as the program that lets you operate and customize it. You provide words, and it uses the model plus its features and extensions to produce an image.
howItWorks: Write a text prompt describing the image you want.
AUTOMATIC1111 uses Stable Diffusion as the base image-generation model.
Its features and extensions provide ways to customize the output.
The program returns an image generated from the prompt and chosen customizations.
explainer.whyItMatters: It provides an open-source program for Stable Diffusion-based text-to-image generation, with a large set of extensions and features for tailoring output rather than relying only on a fixed prompt-to-image path.
misconceptions: AUTOMATIC1111 is not the Stable Diffusion base model; it is the program that uses that model.
Its extensions and features customize the workflow and output; they are not the base model itself.
